top_signals.title: Younan: Regional Tensions Not New for Sovereign Funds
top_signals.summary: Strategic partnerships are becoming increasingly important for sovereign wealth funds in the Gulf region. Despite recent geopolitical volatility, Gulf SWFs have continued investing actively, in an effort to prioritize long term value creation and reduce risk. Wael Younan, Sovereign Wealth Management Head at TCW Group spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar about the strategy of these funds in light of geopolitical tensions. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
top_signals.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
